data.name: RWR:Renegade
data.detailed_description:
RWR: Renegade is Arcade action with beat 'em up, shooter, and motorcycle racing elements. It stands for Ride, Wreck, Reap. Ride your bike. Wreck your enemies. Reap a harvest of parasitic worms.

You are a biker nomad — a metalhead at heart — caught at the epicenter of a nightmare. Deep underground, pollution has caused worms to mutate. Now they can mimic humans, they're bursting to the surface, and poisoning everything around. The city has fallen. People are fleeing. But our hero doesn't back down — he sets out to save the world the only way he knows how.

The madman's arsenal:

  • Bare fists and boots — punches, combos, and improvised weapons. A long combo triggers a speed mode: time slows down around you, while you keep moving, punching, and shooting at normal speed.

  • Firearms — powerful and effective, but ammo is limited. Each weapon type has unique properties.

  • Bike — fast ramming speed and quick traversal. But be careful: control and maneuverability are worse than on foot.

What awaits you:

  • Various enemies — from common worms to giant worms that tear through the city, and something huge and dangerous clawing its way to the surface.

  • Diverse locations — city districts, sewers, a forest, a riverbank with docks, a cemetery, and much more.

  • Friendly NPCs with quests — help survivors, earn useful items and gear.

  • Upgrades — improve your weapons and bike to become stronger, faster, and more ruthless.

  • Bosses — large-scale, unique enemies that will test everything you've learned.

Each approach has its pros and cons — the choice is yours. Fight up close — you risk getting hit, but you build powerful combos. Pick up a gun — you pay with limited ammo. Hop on the bike — you tear through enemies like a storm, but say goodbye to precise maneuvers.

Ride. Wreck. Reap. Rock-chip tunes, tons of lead, an old steel stallion, and no mercy for parasitic worms. The world can still be saved — if you have enough rage and courage.

data.short_description: Hand-to-hand combat, firearms, and an upgradable motorcycle against mimic worms. Play as a biker nomad who crushes everything in his path to the sound of rock-chip tunes.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 7, 8/8.1, 10, 11
  • Processor: Intel Pentium G6400 / AMD Athlon 3000G
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GT 1030 / Radeon RX 550
  • Storage: 120 MB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 7, 8/8.1, 10, 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-10100 / Ryzen 3 3100
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050 / Radeon RX 560
  • Storage: 120 MB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL compatible
